en.title: UN investigators confirm Israel committed war crimes in West Bank
en.dek: UN report cites extermination, torture, and expulsions by Israeli forces.
facts: According to Al Jazeera, UN investigators described Israeli actions as crimes against humanity in the West Bank.
The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry said Israeli forces carried out expulsions and demolitions in Hebron.
Al Jazeera reports that more than 3,000 Palestinians were forced from homes in Hebron.
The commission found that 1,143 Palestinians were killed in the West Bank between Oct 7, 2023 and Oct 9, 2026.
The Israeli mission in Geneva said the report is part of a misinformation campaign.
body: According to Al Jazeera, the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory released a report on 26 October 2026 that identified crimes against humanity by Israeli forces in the West Bank, including extermination, torture, rape and other sexual violence.

The commission, which was established by the UN Human Rights Council in 2021, said Israeli military operations and settler violence in the West Bank constitute a widespread and systematic attack against civilians.

Al Jazeera reports that more than 3,000 Palestinians were forced from their homes in the city of Hebron during a clampdown that began on 20 October 2026, and that the Israeli army has demolished residential buildings and blocked roads.
According to the Israeli mission in Geneva, the report is part of a misinformation campaign to demonise Israel and portray its existence as criminal, and it calls for the commission’s dissolution.

The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported that between Oct 7, 2023 and Oct 9, 2026, 1,143 Palestinians, including at least 250 children, were killed in the occupied West Bank, according to Al Jazeera.
en.context: The West Bank has been occupied by Israel since 1967. According to Al Jazeera, the UN commission said the situation deteriorated after Hamas’s attack on Israel on 7 October 2023. The commission claims Israeli forces intended to collectively punish West Bank civilians in response to that attack.
